summary: Reproduced the cloud wait against an actions/checkout shallow clone contract and replaced ambiguous fetch behavior with an explicit main remote-tracking refspec
issues: git fetch origin main did not guarantee origin/main refresh in shallow GitHub Actions checkouts
risks: health verification intentionally fails closed when the explicit remote ref cannot be refreshed
lessons: a successful fetch command does not prove the remote-tracking ref consumed by later reads was updated
reusable_rules: cloud health fetches must explicitly update the exact remote-tracking ref they inspect
